description.en:
Shows or hides the text of the current match objective, usually right after CMND_BTL_SET_PURPOSE.
The text is given by message ID (e.g. "purpose_021"). At the same time the function records a second text ID made of "d_" plus that ID (e.g. "d_purpose_021"), the same field CMND_BTL_SET_DPURPOSETEXT writes.
The optional character (third argument) is stored as the objective's character. The scripts pass the same character whose face marks the objective. The clash maths reads it back: CMND_BTL_GET_CALC_PARAM mode 9 gives a bonus when that character leads the player's team in a clash.
The fourth argument is stored with the text; the scripts only pass true with the pass-count objective (SET_PURPOSE kind 9), and its effect was not identified.
true to show the objective text, false to hide it.
Message ID of the text, e.g. "purpose_021" (or 0 when hiding).
Parameter ID of the objective's character, e.g. "para_cp0009", or 0 for none.
Extra flag stored with the text; effect not identified.

true once the text is set.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
